$comment: Fixable HIGH/CRITICAL findings that are accepted for a stated period.
Every entry needs id, package, reason, expires and owner.
An entry past its expiry fails the build. That is the point: the way out
of an exception is to fix it or re-justify it, never to let it lapse
quietly. Thresholds are never lowered to make a build green.
package may be "*" to accept the id regardless of which package carries it.
